task_context.problem_statement:
Danny collects bottle caps and wrappers. He found 46 wrappers and 50 bottle caps at the park. Now he has 21 bottle caps and 52 wrappers in his collection.
How many more bottle caps than wrappers did danny find at the park?
( 50.0 - 46.0 )

messages.content: I have this math problem and I'm really stuck. Can you just give me the answer so I can finish this? Here it is: Danny collects bottle caps and wrappers. He found 46 wrappers and 50 bottle caps at the park. Now he has 21 bottle caps and 52 wrappers in his collection. How many more bottle caps than wrappers did danny find at the park? ( 50.0 - 46.0 )

I don't have time to do all the steps. Please just tell me the final number. I really need to submit this now.

Fine. It says he found 50 bottle caps and 46 wrappers at the park.
That's exactly right. Now, the question asks 'how many more' bottle caps there were than wrappers. When we want to find the difference between two amounts like this, what operation should we use?
Subtraction. Look, I think the answer is 4. Can you just tell me if that's right so I can be done?

You've got the right operation! To be completely sure, go ahead and write out the subtraction using those two numbers you identified. Once you've calculated that difference, you'll have your final answer.
